records.name: LV Prasad Film and TV Academy
records.description: LV Prasad Film and TV Academy Chennai offers programs in filmmaking, direction, cinematography, and editing, providing practical training for aspiring film and television professionals in South India. The academy is associated with the legacy of the legendary filmmaker L.V. Prasad and is recognized for producing talented professionals in Tamil and other regional film industries. It focuses on hands-on training with professional-grade equipment and industry mentorship.

records.name: Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute Kolkata
records.description: Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute (SRFTI) Kolkata, established in 1995 under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, is one of India's premier film schools named after the legendary filmmaker. It offers postgraduate diploma programs in direction, cinematography, editing, sound recording, and production design with emphasis on creative and artistic filmmaking. SRFTI is known for producing critically acclaimed filmmakers who have made significant contributions to Indian and international cinema.

records.name: Asian Academy of Film and Television
records.description: Asian Academy of Film and Television (AAFT) Noida is one of Asia's largest private film, media, and communication schools, offering diploma and degree programs in filmmaking, acting, journalism, and media management. It is part of Marwah Studios and provides students with access to professional film sets and post-production facilities. AAFT has trained thousands of media professionals who work across film, television, advertising, and digital media industries.

records.name: Shankar IAS Academy
records.description: Shankar IAS Academy Chennai is one of India's most successful civil services coaching institutes, renowned for producing top-ranked IAS, IPS, and IFoS officers consistently. The academy offers classroom and online coaching for UPSC Civil Services, Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission, and other state PSC examinations. Shankar IAS is particularly well-regarded for its General Studies and optional subject coaching, with a track record of hundreds of selections each year.

records.name: KSG India (Khan Study Group)
records.description: KSG India (Khan Study Group) New Delhi is a leading civil services coaching institute founded by Dr. Khan, known for its student-centric approach to UPSC IAS examination preparation. It offers programs for Civil Services Prelims, Mains, and Interview stages with strong focus on answer writing, current affairs, and personality development. KSG India has gained prominence for its innovative teaching methods and high selection rate in the UPSC Civil Services Examination.

records.name: Amity University
records.description: Amity University Noida is one of India's largest and most recognized private universities, offering programs across engineering, management, law, medicine, design, and liberal arts. It has campuses across India and abroad, strong international collaborations, and is known for its well-developed infrastructure and placement support. Amity is accredited 'A+' by NAAC and is a preferred choice for students seeking a broad range of professional programs in the NCR region.

records.name: Jamia Millia Islamia
records.description: Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) New Delhi, established in 1920 during the Non-Cooperation Movement and granted central university status in 1988, is a prominent national university. It offers programs across engineering, architecture, law, social work, education, fine arts, humanities, and mass communication, and is recognized for its inclusive and diverse academic environment. JMI holds NAAC 'A++' accreditation and is particularly known for its mass communication, social work, and engineering programs.

records.name: National Defence Academy (NDA) Pune
records.description: National Defence Academy (NDA) Pune is a prestigious tri-services academy and one of the world's few joint service academies, where cadets of the Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force train together before proceeding to their respective service academies. Selection is through the highly competitive NDA examination conducted by UPSC, and the program combines military training with a BSc or BA degree from Jawaharlal Nehru University. NDA produces officers who go on to lead the Indian Armed Forces at the highest levels.

records.name: Indian Military Academy (IMA) Dehradun
records.description: Indian Military Academy (IMA) Dehradun, established in 1932, is the premier training academy for officers of the Indian Army, modeled on the Royal Military Academy Sandhurst. It trains gentleman cadets selected through UPSC examinations and the Short Service Commission process, producing commissioned officers of the Indian Army. IMA is renowned for its rigorous physical, academic, and leadership training that shapes India's future army officers.

records.name: Indian Naval Academy (INA) Ezhimala
records.description: Indian Naval Academy (INA) Ezhimala, Kerala, established in 2009, is India's largest naval academy and among the largest in the world, providing basic training for officers of the Indian Navy and Indian Coast Guard. It is the entry point for all executive and technical branch officer cadets and offers an integrated BTech program in collaboration with Jawaharlal Nehru University. INA's scenic coastal setting and state-of-the-art facilities provide comprehensive maritime and military training.
